# cockpit for Claude Code (izzatum/claude-code-cockpit)

> cockpit for Claude Code is a plugin that puts context usage and session cost in the status line, adds a budget alert and a `/cockpit` dashboard with rate limits and MCP server health, and blocks `rm -rf` and other recursive deletes in Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive and OneDrive folders. Free and open source (MIT). Version 0.3.0 (see plugin.json). Tested on Claude Code 2.1.295.

A community plugin by izzatum, not affiliated with Anthropic, and not related to the Cockpit Linux web console. For developers who use Claude Code in a terminal, especially with projects inside a cloud-synced folder. The GitHub repo izzatum/claude-code-cockpit is also its plugin marketplace.

Install inside Claude Code: `/plugin install cockpit --marketplace izzatum/claude-code-cockpit`. From a shell: `claude plugin install cockpit --marketplace izzatum/claude-code-cockpit` (add `--config budget=10` to set an option), or `claude plugin marketplace add izzatum/claude-code-cockpit`, then `claude plugin install cockpit@claude-code-cockpit`.

Key facts:

- Status line format: `<project or tag> · ctx <N>% · $<cost> · <modes>`, for example `web-app · ctx 31% · $0.84 · caveman`. Modes are joined by `+` (for example `caveman+ponytail:full`) and omitted when none are on.
- Settings: `budget` (number, US dollars, default 5, 0 turns the alert off), `compactTools` (boolean, default true), `projectTags` (string of `needle=Label` pairs split by `;`, default empty).
- Budget alert: one pop-up per session and budget value; `/clear` or a new budget value re-arms it.
- The cloud-sync guard checks every Bash and Monitor command before it runs. In a synced folder it blocks `rm -r`/`rm -rf`/`rm --recursive`, `git rm -r` (not `--cached`), `find -delete`, `rsync --delete` and `git clean -f`, and warns before `npm`/`pnpm`/`yarn`/`bun` installs and builds, `pip install` and `cargo build`. It reads command text only: it is a safety net, not a sandbox.
- While the shell is inside a synced folder, every recursive delete is blocked, wherever it points.
- If the guard errors, it refuses any recursive delete, judged on command text, in any folder.
- MCP health comes from `claude mcp list`, run 30 seconds after session start and when `/cockpit` opens, at most once every 10 minutes. One pop-up if the session's first check finds a failed server.
- Context usage and cost are the figures Claude Code reports; cockpit does not count tokens, keep cost history or call any model.

## Docs

- [README (Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit/HEAD/README.md): the full documentation as plain Markdown
- [Quick start](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#quick-start): install in one command
- [Features](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#features): status line, dashboard, budget alert, cloud-sync guard, MCP server health, compact tool rows, spinner tag
- [Use the dashboard](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#use-the-dashboard): opening and closing `/cockpit`, pane size, context bar colours, modes
- [Settings](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#settings): `budget`, `compactTools`, `projectTags`
- [rm -rf guard for Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive and OneDrive](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#rm--rf-guard-for-dropbox-icloud-drive-google-drive-and-onedrive): synced folders recognised, and which commands are blocked, warned or allowed
- [Limits and caveats](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#limits-and-caveats): what the guard misses, what cost and rate limits mean, MCP check timing
- [cockpit vs ccusage, /cost, /context and statusLine scripts](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#cockpit-vs-ccusage-cost-context-and-statusline-scripts): how cockpit compares with built-in commands, custom status line scripts and usage-report CLIs
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#troubleshooting): missing status line, MCP "unavailable", guard "could not check"
- [Uninstall](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#uninstall): remove the plugin and marketplace

## FAQ

- [How do I see Claude Code context usage?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-see-claude-code-context-usage): built-in `/context` on request; cockpit keeps `ctx N%` in the status line and a context bar with the token count in `/cockpit`.
- [How do I track Claude Code cost per session?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-track-claude-code-cost-per-session): built-in `/cost` on request; cockpit keeps the session cost in the status line, updated after each turn.
- [How do I get a budget alert in Claude Code?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-get-a-budget-alert-in-claude-code): set cockpit's `budget` option (default 5 US dollars) with `/plugin configure cockpit@claude-code-cockpit`.
- [Does the cost figure apply on a Claude Pro or Max subscription?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#does-the-cost-figure-apply-on-a-claude-pro-or-max-subscription): it is Claude Code's own estimate, not a bill; `budget` 0 turns the alert off.
- [Can Claude Code delete files in my Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive or OneDrive?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#can-claude-code-delete-files-in-my-dropbox-icloud-drive-google-drive-or-onedrive): yes; cockpit's guard blocks recursive deletes in those folders.
- [Is it safe to run Claude Code in a Dropbox, iCloud Drive or OneDrive folder?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#is-it-safe-to-run-claude-code-in-a-dropbox-icloud-drive-or-onedrive-folder): it works, but deletes sync to every device and installs queue thousands of uploads; prefer a local clone, or let cockpit's guard block recursive deletes there.
- [How do I stop Claude Code from running rm -rf?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-stop-claude-code-from-running-rm--rf): a permissions deny rule in settings.json, or a hook that checks each command before it runs, such as cockpit's guard for synced folders.
- [Why use a hook instead of a CLAUDE.md rule?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#why-use-a-hook-instead-of-a-claudemd-rule): Claude Code runs the hook before each command, whatever the model decides; a CLAUDE.md rule can be missed.
- [How do I add a custom status line to Claude Code?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-add-a-custom-status-line-to-claude-code): the `statusLine` setting runs your own script; cockpit provides one with no script to maintain.
- [How do I see my Claude Code 5-hour rate limit?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-see-my-claude-code-5-hour-rate-limit): when Claude Code reports rate limits, `/cockpit` shows one bar per limit with the percent used.
- [What is the difference between cockpit, ccusage and ccstatusline?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#what-is-the-difference-between-cockpit-ccusage-and-ccstatusline): live session view plus a synced-folder guard, versus cost history, versus a configurable status line.
- [How do I check whether my MCP servers are connected?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-check-whether-my-mcp-servers-are-connected): `/mcp` or `claude mcp list`; cockpit counts connected, need-sign-in and failed servers in `/cockpit`.
- [How do I install a Claude Code plugin from GitHub?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#how-do-i-install-a-claude-code-plugin-from-github): add the repository as a marketplace, then install the plugin from it.
- [Does cockpit work on Windows, Linux and WSL?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#does-cockpit-work-on-windows-linux-and-wsl): it is TypeScript with no native parts; the guard recognises macOS, Linux and Windows paths; the MCP check needs `claude` on PATH.
- [Is cockpit free?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#is-cockpit-free): yes, MIT, with no account, API key or model calls.
- [Does cockpit send my data anywhere?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#does-cockpit-send-my-data-anywhere): no requests of its own; `claude mcp list` connects to each configured MCP server.
- [Is the context percentage exact?](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit#is-the-context-percentage-exact): as exact as Claude Code's own figure, shown as-is.

## Source

- [plugin.json](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit/blob/HEAD/plugins/cockpit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): plugin name, version and settings schema
- [marketplace.json](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit/blob/HEAD/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): the claude-code-cockpit marketplace manifest
- [hooks/register.tsx](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit/blob/HEAD/plugins/cockpit/hooks/register.tsx): status line, dashboard pane, budget alert, MCP check, guard and render hooks
- [hooks/logic.ts](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit/blob/HEAD/plugins/cockpit/hooks/logic.ts): the guard's patterns and other plain functions
- [tests/logic.test.ts](https://github.com/izzatum/claude-code-cockpit/blob/HEAD/plugins/cockpit/tests/logic.test.ts): example commands the guard blocks, warns about and allows
